option_relations.rationale: Tumors of the follicular infundibulum (TFI) match the histopathologic findings of plate-like subepidermal tumor extending horizontally under epidermis with multiple cord-like connections to overlying epidermis
Clear cell hidradenoma does not match the clinical presentation or histopathologic findings
Clear cell (pale cell) basal cell carcinoma does not match the clinical presentation or histopathologic findings
Trichoepithelioma does not match the clinical presentation or histopathologic findings
